Faster Boot Sequence is an Engineering Blueprint for Frame Shift Drives that reduces drive boot time and adds a smaller optimized-mass bonus, with heat and integrity tradeoffs.

{{#invoke:EngineeringBlueprints|infobox|fsd_faster_boot_sequence}}

== What It Does ==
Faster Boot Sequence helps a Frame Shift Drive come online faster after power-up. It is most relevant to power-managed ships or builds where module startup timing matters.
